subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers continue using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 as the canonical fix path for this issue, or replace it with a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not whether the bug exists; it is whether the stale, dirty, proof-blocked linked branch should be refreshed/narrowed or superseded by a cleaner implementation path.

options.title: Refresh the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve its merge/proof/API-contract blockers, and close this issue only after it merges.

options.title: Replace with a narrow PR
options.body: Close or supersede the linked PR only after opening a current-main replacement that preserves the useful MIME/WebP fix without unapproved API surface.

options.title: Leave issue parked
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new repair lane until a maintainer has time to sponsor the Discord media fix path.

recommendation.title: Refresh the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve its merge/proof/API-contract blockers, and close this issue only after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send helper and plugin-SDK contract surfaces involved in the linked PR decision.
